headline: SML Mahindra Limited: Outcome of Board Meeting
sum: Outcome of Board Meeting - SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 06, 2026 has inter-alia, considered and approved raising of funds through the issuance of fully paid-up equity…
detail: Outcome of Board Meeting - SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 06, 2026 has inter-alia, considered and approved raising of funds through the issuance of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company of the face value of Rs. 10/- each by way of a rights issue (the "Rights Issue") for an amount not exceeding Rs. 1450 Crore (Rupees One Thousand Four Hundred and Fifty Crore) to the eligible equity shareholders of the Company as on the record date (to be determined and notified subsequently), subject to receipt of regulatory and statutory approvals, as may be applicable in accordance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India…
